event: Vesper deploys the Field Forge at the rest node's center and starts crafting.
Solenne sets her staff against the wall and sits down.
Dayo sits on a raised root shelf, working her stiff left shoulder.
The rest node's regeneration field raises the party's HP.
Tomás walks the perimeter checking the three access points.
Tomás sits against the far wall where he can watch all three entries.
Nadia lies flat on her back in the center, theatrically resting.
Miriam moves toward Dayo.
Solenne raises the north wall with Tomás.
Solenne shows her private notebook with the door's coordinates already written.
Solenne asks what True Sight gave him.
Tomás describes a sealed 3x4 m space behind the wall, responsive to Harmony Mana.
Tomás confirms he is sure about the Harmony specificity.
Solenne says it is the third; Tomás lists Floors 5, 6 and 7.
Solenne notes all three sit between a cleared chamber and a rest node.
Tomás says Floor 5's anomaly was the first, pausing briefly over it.
Tomás says Floor 6's sealed space held a resonance echo, something older.
Tomás calls three data points a pattern.
Solenne senses Tomás is not telling her everything but does not push.
Solenne writes the pattern down, underlining Harmony-specific twice.
Solenne asks for Tomás's full True Sight logs; he nods without a timeline.
Vesper works quick crafting cycles at the Forge.
Nadia sits cross-legged beside Vesper to watch her hands.
Nadia pitches a grenade that makes enemies existentially sad; Vesper says no.
Nadia pitches a combatively good-smelling potion; Vesper says she is making antidotes.
Nadia pitches a thrown item that plays a nice song; Vesper's hands pause briefly.
Vesper does not send Nadia away; Nadia settles against the wall in quiet company.
Vesper crafts three healing potions.
Vesper crafts two antidotes, two paralysis gels and two Mana Vials.
Vesper lines up the nine items in the tray without announcing them.
Miriam wraps a shallow mandible cut on Dayo's forearm in linen.
Dayo sits still and lets Miriam tend her.
Solenne glimpses Miriam's notebook: Dayo's HP, a shoulder note, an odd symbol.
Dayo thanks Miriam; Miriam says 'Mm' and closes the notebook.
A loose group conversation starts about the crawlers.
Tomás mentions the map's colony count discrepancy; Solenne feels it as a miss.
Vesper suggests a seasonal clustering pattern explains the discrepancy.
Nadia jokes 'Distributed reproduction is my stage name'; Dayo laughs hard.
Talk turns to what each misses; Dayo says open ground.
Vesper says she misses deadlines and projects with a completion date.
Tomás says he misses early light on open land; the node goes quiet.
Miriam smiles and does not answer; Nadia watches her closely.
Dayo asks Nadia; Nadia jokes she misses having no opinions on structural integrity.
Nadia turns to Solenne and asks if she actually likes the Tower.
Nadia rules out 'useful' and 'interesting' and asks again if Solenne likes it.
Solenne opens her mouth, closes it, then says yes.
Solenne explains she likes that everything inside the Tower is connected.
Solenne admits she hates the price but loves the Tower for that quality.
Solenne realizes she has never said this to anyone.
Nadia says softly that's what she thought.
The others look at Solenne; Vesper stops working; nobody comments.
The party settles toward sleep; Dayo falls asleep first on her shelf.
Nadia curls up near the Forge with her green scarf around her ears.
Tomás rests in his watchful half-sleep.
Miriam checks each sleeper and adjusts Nadia's slipped scarf.
Vesper finishes a final unidentified item and shuts down the Field Forge.
Solenne sits awake with her notebook, thinking of 94/96 and her RES of 18.
Solenne's Status Window opens with a gold-bordered notification.
Solenne receives the personal Quest 'The Trueweave's Question'.
Solenne reads it twice; the System has never used her Aspect name before.
Solenne closes and reopens the notification; the gold border pulses once.
Solenne decides not to show the party yet.
Solenne feels watched with interest, not threat.
Solenne stays awake a long time, unafraid, feeling something has started.
